import pathlib
from datetime import datetime

def report_paths(root):
    # Ensure the root is a pathlib.Path object
    root = pathlib.Path(root)
    
    # Filter files in the root directory that match the report pattern
    report_files = [f for f in root.iterdir() if f.name.startswith("report-") and f.name.endswith(".csv")]
    
    # Convert the report file names to datetime objects
    report_dates = [datetime.strptime(f.name.split("-")[1], "%Y-%m-%d") for f in report_files]
    
    # Sort the report files by date in ascending order
    report_files.sort(key=lambda x: report_dates[x.name.split("-")[1]])
    
    # Return the sorted list of (day, path) pairs
    return [(report_dates[i].date(), report_files[i]) for i in range(len(report_files))]
